options.content:
## 📖 About This Dashboard

**Data sources**
| Source | Covers | Endpoint |
|--------|--------|----------|
| Prometheus | Auth metrics, Sessions, OAuth2 counters & latency | `/openam/json/metrics/prometheus` (AM 6/7/8) |
| Elasticsearch | Audit log events (auth, session, OAuth2, access) | Your PingAM audit index |

---

### 🔧 Metric Name Quick-Start

PingAM exposes metrics as **Micrometer Summaries**. Use `label_values()` or Prometheus `/api/v1/label/__name__/values` to discover your exact names.

| What | Likely metric name | Key labels |
|------|--------------------|-----------|
| Auth attempts | `am_authentication_count` | `outcome` (success/failure), `realm` |
| Auth latency | `am_authentication` (quantile) | `quantile`, `realm` |
| Active sessions | `am_sessions_statistic` | `statistic` (activeSessions), `realm` |
| Session events | `am_sessions_statistic` | `statistic` (sessionsCreated/Destroyed/TimedOut) |
| OAuth2 grants | `am_oauth2_count` | `grant_type`, `realm` |
| OAuth2 tokens (active) | `am_oauth2_accessToken_count` | `realm` |
| Tree node exec | `am_trees_nodeExecution_count` | `tree`, `node`, `realm` |

> **Tip:** Run `curl -s https://<am-host>/openam/json/metrics/prometheus | grep '^am_'` to list all exposed metric names in your environment.

---

### 🗂️ Elasticsearch Audit Log Fields

| Field | Example value | Notes |
|-------|---------------|-------|
| `@timestamp` | `2026-08-11T10:00:00Z` | Time of event |
| `component` | `AUTHENTICATION`, `OAUTH2`, `SESSION`, `ACCESS` | Audit category |
| `eventName` | `AM-AUTH-LOGIN-COMPLETED` | Specific event identifier |
| `realm` | `/alpha` | Realm path |
| `result` | `SUCCESSFUL`, `FAILED` | Outcome |
| `principal` | `user@example.com` | Acting principal |
| `transactionId` | `abc-123` | Links related events |

Adjust the `$es_index` variable to match your index pattern (default: `pingam-audit-*`).
